sources.scope_limit: Historical weight-based IV trial; not a direct trial of 200 mg q3w or 400 mg q6w. Current dose and eligibility come from NCCP.
RFS concerns recurrence/death after surgery, not survival with metastatic disease. This was not a 400 mg q6w trial.
Stage IIB/IIC cohort; do not combine with stage III figures or call recurrence-free survival an overall-survival estimate.
The NCCP 200 mg note is narrower: selected eligible stage IIIB patients. EFS includes failure to reach/complete planned treatment, recurrence and death; OS was not established at this analysis.
Trial-specific first-line BRAF-wild-type population. No direct fixed-dose q4w or subcutaneous efficacy comparison is established by these figures.
Active comparator, not placebo. This historical weight-based IV trial does not directly compare current fixed IV and subcutaneous schedules.
